reference_wrapper.role: external seed-setting reference that invokes the unchanged ProvXExplainer API; any production wrapper must preserve the recorded RNG controls and receive its own hash

primary.selection_rule: Use the first seed in the immutable registration list; register it before acquiring or inspecting FA1B2de formal outcomes.
primary.purpose: single primary Phase-II result for the frozen formal evaluation

optional_sensitivity.selection_rule: If enabled, run every declared sensitivity seed on the same frozen inputs/configuration and report all results; do not add or remove seeds after viewing formal outcomes.

rng_controls.python_hash: set PYTHONHASHSEED to the decimal seed before interpreter start
rng_controls.cuda_backend: When CUDA is used, set torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic=true and benchmark=false and record device/driver; the R1/R2 baseline is CPU-only.
rng_controls.process_isolation: Set all controls in the wrapper process before model/explainer construction.
rng_controls.graph_order: Use the frozen deterministic graph and edge order from the route manifest.
rng_controls.retry_rule: A rerun uses the same registered seed and configuration; infrastructure retries receive a new run ID and retain both manifests.

phase2_scope.controlled_operation: all Phase-II explanations in a run, including any graph iteration order
phase2_scope.track_o_config: artifact-as-shipped Phase-II defaults recorded in PROVX_R1_PHASE2_SAMPLE_RUN.json and PROVX_R2_SCHEMA_AND_DETERMINISM_REPORT.md
phase2_scope.track_l_config: separately frozen with the new 32-input detector before formal evaluation

comparison_and_reporting.semantic_identity: Canonical hash over run metadata, explanation edge_index tensor, edge_weight tensor, prediction, and target label.
comparison_and_reporting.raw_torch_file_hash: Informational only because Torch ZIP member names can contain the output filename; do not treat differing archive hashes as semantic nondeterminism.
comparison_and_reporting.forbid_metric_only_summary: Retain per-graph explanation content and canonical hashes, not only aggregate metrics.

pre_registration_attestation.policy_mutation_after_formal_eval: requires a new policy_id and a separately labeled evaluation; it cannot overwrite this registration

next_action: Fresh review of the R3 live route decision before any formal evaluation.
